answer: In this PoA design, bonded collateral is the anchor: when k coordinated identities equivocate on the same consensus event, pairwise correlation drives penalties proportional to k², rather than treating each identity as an isolated fault. Detection also applies an exponential multiplier to the swarm’s aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation makes unrecovered bonds lose value over time. Thus splitting control into sybils amplifies exposure; an echo of coordinated misconduct can leave each ember of collateral worth less.
